name: Sour Patch Kids & Sour Gummies (Citric Acid Mucosal Irritant Warning)
whyItWorks: Sour Patch Kids are coated in a heavy crystalline layer of malic and citric acid. In active Crohn's or Colitis with aphthous ulcers or intestinal denudation, these concentrated acids burn raw tissue and stimulate burning, painful cramps.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Flare Warning: Avoid heavily sour candies. Choose standard sweet gummy bears or Swedish Fish instead.
watchOuts: Violates citrus-free guardrail; high citric and malic acid concentrations irritate gut ulcerations.
